family: instrument (fitting precision, depth fidelity, masks/census, model-class ladder, data scaling)

figures.finding: bf16-vs-fp32 relative error falls with depth to 1.2-1.5% at the per-mask medians by L16, but the text mask shows 49.2% relative error at L0 - X6 verdict: production = fp32 + TF32.

figures.gap: S2 depth-curve JSON absent from raw/ (raw/step3/ holds only fit manifests); figure uses S1 only, as instructed.
figures.finding: The J-lens beats the untrained logit lens on mean rank at every layer except the L17-24 mid-layer bump (worse at 5/8 of those layers; mean rank 2228.8 vs 2119.3), and is exact at L31 (rank 27.31 = the model's own, KL = 0, top-1 = 1.00).

Position census (50 samples): image patches are 88.7% of the 32,454 positions, and the BOS sink is the outlier - the smallest group norm at L0 (8.3) but 1,569 by L16 (188x), ~42x the text norms, decaying to 634 by L31.

key_numbers.citation: DECISIONS.md D41 (table, lines 859-871) and D42; no lens_zoo JSON under raw/

figures.finding: Affine correction does the early work, transport the late work: bias+scale lifts LQS from -0.102 to +0.766, logit_bias to +0.922, and the tmtext50 refit to +0.947; rank-32 translators lead overall (1.714-1.718) but are 3x worse at L30 (5.62-5.82 vs 1.30-1.79).

key_numbers.citation: DECISIONS.md D43; no step8/lens_zoo_scaling.json under raw/

figures.finding: The J-class is data-saturated (flat LQS 0.92-0.95 by n~100) while the translator's held-out LQS keeps rising ~linearly in log n: 1.714@40 -> 2.043@100 -> 2.691@500 -> 3.009@1000 - the production recommendation flips to the translator (n>=1000, keep scaling).
